description: The Warp app and Open WebUI's desktop app and PyPI package on macOS, beside Arc, which must claim nothing.
why: Each bundle id is a raw probe, for 13's reason: Warp and Open WebUI also match on the brew route, so must_find alone would pass with either bundle id broken. Open WebUI's uv tool directory is a third witness, held by must_contain. Arc is installed so that its bundle id is a real row the catalog declines, and the scenario finds exactly its must_find, so Arc claiming anything fails it. dia is forbidden because Arc's vendor makes it, perplexity-comet because it is another Chromium browser, and aider because its uv tool directory is read by the same route.
known_gaps: Sign-in gated: neither app is launched, so nothing exercises what each writes once used.
